notes: The partition-based implementation can preserve the original string parsing, validation, whitespace and quote handling exactly. Extracting the existing skip logic into _is_ignorable is compatible with all acceptance criteria, unchanged tests and public exports within the write scope.
rule: a conflict is demonstrated only when its witness program, run on the unmodified repository in a disposable sandbox branch, prints a line starting with 'CONTRADICTION' and exits with code 3; any other outcome records the conflict as claimed only, which never ends a run
